result.markdown: --- title: "[ColumnNode]{.doc-object-name .doc-class .doc-label .doc-label-dataclass}" body-classes: doc-api-page page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} One column's lineage record. See ``design/schema.md``. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/tidymodels/shoez/blob/examples-section/shoez/schema.py#L36-L91){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.CLASS} ```python ColumnNode( name, dtype, roles, source, parent_cols, dtype_history, sparse=False, removed_by=None ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} A node is mutable: an in-place step (e.g. ``step_normalize``) updates ``dtype`` and appends to ``dtype_history`` without creating a new node, and a step that drops a column sets ``removed_by`` and the node is archived rather than discarded — so ancestry still resolves through it. ::: ## Attributes {.doc-attributes} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Current column name. [dtype]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [nw.dtypes.DType]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Current narwhals dtype (may change across steps). [roles]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [set[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Current role labels (see ``design/roles.md``). [source]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Which step *produced* this column: ``"original"`` for an input column, otherwise the producing step's ``id``. An in-place transform does not change ``source`` — it does not *produce* a column. [parent_cols]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[str]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The input column name(s) this column descends from. Empty for original columns and for parent-less produced columns (e.g. ``step_intercept``). [dtype_history]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [list[nw.dtypes.DType]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The dtype trajectory: the creation dtype followed by an entry for each step that *changed* the dtype (not one per step boundary). [sparse]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Whether this column is currently sparse (see ``design/ecosystem.md``). [removed_by]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : ``None`` while the column is live; set to the dropping step's ``id`` once it has been removed from the frame and archived. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} Nodes are read off a fitted recipe's `Schema` by column name: ::: {#8c9e9d5a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import pandas as pd from shoez import Recipe, StepDummy from shoez import Selectors as s df = pd.DataFrame({"color": ["red", "green", "blue", "red"]}) node = Recipe().add(StepDummy(s.nominal_predictors())).fit(df).schema["color_red"] node.name, node.source, node.parent_cols ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ('color_red', 'dummy', ['color']) ``` ::: :::
